crossRefs.note: “You shall not blaspheme God, nor curse a ruler of your people.
Also to punish the righteous is not good, nor to flog officials for their integrity.
Then Paul said to him, “God will strike you, you whitewashed wall! Do you sit to judge me according to the law, and…
Paul said, “I didn’t know, brothers, that he was high priest. For it is written, ‘You shall not speak evil of a ruler…
Therefore give everyone what you owe: if you owe taxes, pay taxes; if customs, then customs; if respect, then respect…
Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.
but chiefly those who walk after the flesh in the lust of defilement and despise authority. Daring, self-willed, they…
Yet in the same way, these also in their dreaming defile the flesh, despise authority, and slander celestial beings.

translations.web: Who says to a king, ‘Vile!’ or to nobles, ‘Wicked!’?
translations.bsb: who says to kings, ‘You are worthless!’ and to nobles, ‘You are wicked,’
translations.kjv: Is it fit to say to a king, Thou art wicked? and to princes, Ye are ungodly?
translations.asv: Him that saith to a king, Thou art vile, Or to nobles, Ye are wicked;
